# fastidious

> Excessively particular, difficult to please; painstaking, meticulous, requiring excessive attention to detail

> showing great care and attention to detail; hard to please


## Example

- *Whitney is fastidious about her shoes, arranging them on a shelf in a specific order, each pair evenly spaced.*
